{{Quote|They're all over me! I'm trying to lose them. This is Red Five. I need help!|Pedrin Gaul|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
'''Pedrin Gaul''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who flew as a [[Rebel pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], operating under the [[callsign]] [[Red Five]]. He was a [[transport]] [[pilot]] before helping fugitives who were hunted by the [[Galactic Empire]] escape from [[Denon]], for which he was branded a [[Treason|traitor]] of the Empire. He, as a [[Cadet]], was killed in action while flying his [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] for the Alliance during the [[Battle of Scarif]]. Gaul's callsign was later taken by [[Luke Skywalker]], who destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Pedrin Gaul [[Homeworld|hailed]] from the [[planet]] [[Denon]] and was [[Reproduction|born]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War]]. On his homeworld, he was a [[transport]] [[pilot]] and ferried both passengers and freight throughout the metropolitan skylanes of Denon. He remained in this career until he helped fugitives who were hunted by the [[Galactic Empire]] escape from Denon. For his actions in this exodus, the Empire branded Gaul a [[Treason|traitor]], and he fled his homeworld.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

Gaul joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], became a [[cadet]] in the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]], and was stationed at the [[Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4]]. He flew a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] for [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]] and was given the [[callsign]] [[Red Five]].<ref name="Visual Guide" />

===Routine patrols===
At some point, Gaul was scheduled Shift Cycle 2 of an X-wing flight patrol mission along with fellow pilots Cdt. [[Harb Binli]] ([[Red Seven]]) and [[Lieutenant|Lt.]] [[Nozzo Naytaan]] ([[Red Nine]]). Their mission was to route from [[Yavin Prime|Yavin]] to [[Gordian Reach|Gordian]] Trace Relays, perform a flyby of surrounding space, then after verifying visual and sensor all clear, perform close uplink of passive relay recordings.<ref name="RebelFiles">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>

===Battle of Scarif===
{{Quote|Stick close, Red Five! Where are you going?|[[Garven Dreis]], to Pedrin Gaul|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
[[File:RedFive.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Pedrin Gaul during the Battle of Scarif]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Gaul flew with his [[squadron]] during the [[Battle of Scarif]], where they and the rest of the Alliance Fleet provided support for [[Jyn Erso]] and her team, [[Rogue One]], as they fought to steal the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the Empire's planet-killing [[superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]. Gaul was [[Death|killed]] in action during the battle, as the Alliance attempted to destroy the [[Shield Gate]] that protected [[Scarif]] and, for a time, prevented Rogue One from transmitting the Death Star plans to the Alliance Fleet. The plans were ultimately transmitted and given to [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

At the moment of Gaul's death, Admiral Raddus could hear his anguished scream over the starfighter's frequency.<ref name="Rogue One Novel">[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]]</ref>

===Legacy===
[[File:PedrinEnd.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Gaul's X-wing destroyed during the Battle of Scarif]]
The Red Five callsign was left vacant as a result of Gaul's death. Not long after the Battle of Scarif, aspiring [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] helped Princess Leia bring the plans stolen from Scarif to Yavin 4. The Alliance found the weakness built into the [[battle station]] by its designer,<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen Erso]],<ref name="Rogue One" /> and launched the [[Battle of Yavin]] to destroy the Death Star. Skywalker flew under the Red Five callsign and fired the shot that destroyed the Death Star, honoring the sacrifice of Pedrin Gaul and all those who died on Scarif.<ref name="Episode IV" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Gaul_helmet.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Pedrin Gaul's flight helmet]]
Pedrin Gaul was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] with black [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and light skin. Base One's [[Fighter Boss]] [[Nera Kase]] considered him awkward yet eager.<ref name="Grounded">{{StoryCite|story=Grounded|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> His eagerness was shown when he was a teacher and wingmate to [[Cadet]] [[Harb Binli]].<ref name="Geektionary" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pedrin Gaul was created for the [[2016]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One" /> His backstory was fleshed out in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', by [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] creative executive [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="Visual Guide" />
He was portrayed by stunt performer [[David Forman]].<ref name="Forman">{{WebCite|url=https://careydoddassociates.com/talent/male-actors|text=Male Actors|quote=With many credits, including Pedrin Gaul in ROGUE ONE: A STAR WARS STORY|archivedate=20190808215043}}</ref>
